title: WeatherDreamer: Learning a World Model from Multimodal Earth Observations
abstract: arXiv:2611.18393v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning weather models now rival operational global forecasts but still start from analyses produced by separate, expensive data assimilation (DA) systems, which for global models are typically updated every six hours. Observation-to-observation models avoid this dependence, but most omit the recursive filtering cycle that lets DA systems carry a background state through sparse, irregular observations. We introduce WeatherDreamer, a world model that learns this cycle end-to-end from 18 global observing systems, without reanalysis. It infers a latent state from observations, carries it forward hour by hour with learned dynamics, corrects it each hour with new observations, and can predict what any of its observing systems would measure at any location. At held-out stations, its ensembles beat NOAA's Global Ensemble Forecast System (GEFS) for temperature, dew point and wind out to 12 h and are better calibrated than GEFS and the E

translated_title: WeatherDreamer：从多模态地球观测中学习世界模型
translated_abstract: 机器学习天气模型如今已能媲美业务化的全球预报，但它们仍需以由独立且昂贵的数据同化（DA）系统生成的分析场作为起点，而全球模型的数据同化系统通常每六小时才更新一次。观测到观测的模型避免了这种依赖，但大多数模型忽略了递归滤波循环——正是这一循环使数据同化系统能够借助稀疏且不规则的观测来延续背景状态。我们提出了WeatherDreamer，这是一个从18个全球观测系统中端到端学习该循环的世界模型，无需依赖再分析数据。它从观测中推断潜状态，利用学习到的动力学逐小时向前传播，每小时用新的观测对其进行校正，并能预测其任意观测系统在任何位置会测量到什么。在留出的站点上，其集合预报在温度、露点和风速方面在未来12小时内优于NOAA的全球集合预报系统（GEFS），且比GEFS和E（原文截断）具有更好的校准性。
tldr: WeatherDreamer是一个无需再分析数据、从18个全球观测系统端到端学习递归滤波循环的世界模型，其集合预报在12小时内的温度、露点和风速预测上优于NOAA的GEFS。
en_tdlr: WeatherDreamer is a world model that learns the recursive filtering cycle end-to-end from 18 global observing systems without reanalysis, with ensembles outperforming NOAA's GEFS for temperature, dew point, and wind out to 12 hours.
